summary: Writes the same int value (result) into four consecutive dword slots a2[20], a2[21], a2[22] and a2[23], then returns that value. A compact bulk-initializer for a small run of dwords inside an unknown object. Object and field identity are unknown.

local_names.result: int value written into all four dword slots and returned
local_names.a2: pointer to the dword array whose slots 20 through 23 are written

operations.description: Return the same value (result) that was written to the four dword slots

unresolved: The object owning the a2 dword array and the semantic role of the four written slots are unknown.
Why the caller reuses the written value as the return value is unknown.
